deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (dep org.clojure/clojure, alias :test reduced to :extra-paths, alias :probe, alias :bench, alias :scaling, alias :tiling, alias :tlb, alias :unrolled, alias :calibrate, alias :curve, alias :perarm, alias :lint): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.

nbb.edn.reason: The same git floors as deps.edn are resolved through the bundled libraries by kbb from lib/; the file keeps only the paths.
